# Guild chat. Rank prefixes: none, VIP, VIP+, MVP, MVP+, MVP++, YOUTUBE, ADMIN, MOD, HELPER, PIG+++, OWNER.
> Guild > [MVP+] Steve [Elite]: hello there
= {"kind":"chat","payload":{"chat":"guild","username":"Steve","rank":"MVP+","guildRank":"Elite","message":"hello there","self":false,"relayed":false}}
